title: The catalogue lives in this repo until other people install it

statements.says: The catalogue ships as a Claude Code plugin marketplace, a git repository developers add and Claude Code clones.
The catalogue lives at plugins/ in this repo, beside Studio.
When other developers consume Skillworks as a published plugin, plugins/ is split into its own repository.
Studio takes the catalogue path as configuration from day one, defaulting to plugins/ in this repo.
Nothing in the app assumes the catalogue and Studio live together.
One repo means one build, one version, and no cross-repo testing before there is anything to test.
A marketplace install clones the whole repository, so every consumer would pull Studio's React and C# source to get a folder of Markdown.
Pulling the whole repository is harmless while the only consumer is this machine.
Taking the catalogue path as configuration keeps the split a move rather than a rewrite.
Putting the catalogue in a repo of its own was turned down until other people install it.
